definition: the loves I kept, each severed in the same place, and what never grew back

settled:
Seven loves have each fully contracted at least once and come back partial.

Family, strained. Faith, less active than I was. ESO, played only by myself. LitRPG, read and never talked about. One friend, an hour at a time a few times a year. Products, built for myself and not shared. Nature, almost always alone.

They are not seven losses. They are one cut made seven times. In every one I kept the thing and lost the people in it.

It runs the same way every time because the one punisher I cannot make safe by checking my own work is other people. I cannot read them and cannot forecast them, so solitude became the safe mode of everything.

I resurrect what I love and have proved that seven times over. Every resurrection stops at the same line. They all come back alone, and the acre that never regrows is being seen inside it.

title: The Seven That Came Back Alone
